title: Why Do We Fall for Fake Spiritual Gurus? (1981-10-05)
description:
Struggling with endless thoughts and mental exhaustion? Discover the true cause of overthinking and how to experience absolute inner silence.

This profound public program explores the subtle system, detailing how our energy channels relate to the subconscious past and overthinking future. Shri Mataji addresses false spiritual practices and misconceptions about Kundalini, culminating in a guided self-realization experience and Q&A.

Key Topics:
• ❤️ Mooladhara (Root Chakra) - The center of innocence and why the sacred energy of Kundalini has absolutely no connection to sexual practices
• 🌙 Dangers of the left side (Ida Nadi) - How dwelling on the past and engaging with psychic phenomena exposes us to the collective subconscious
• ☀️ The trap of the right side (Surya Nadi) - Why constant thinking and excessive planning exhaust the brain and prevent true spiritual growth
• 💬 Q&A insights on genuine meditation - Why true spiritual awakening is effortless and cannot be achieved through extreme physical exercises
• ⚡ Guided self-realization experience - Feel the tangible awakening of your Kundalini energy as a cool breeze on your central nervous system

“Once you become that, then you become thoughtlessly aware. You become a witness. You see the whole show as a drama, and you don't get involved into it.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• Sometimes in meditation and in chanting, a person will be rocking. Would you consider that a negative thing?
• At what age does the immune bodies start developing and is there any way in which you can expand their capacity?
• What are the avenues available to keep these channels open?
• Do you feel Hatha Yoga is necessary?
• Is there anything that we can start doing now?
• What kind of a yoga did Lord Krishna practice?
• I wanted to ask You about the meditations from the Maharishi Mahayoga, what Your opinion was.?
• Are there other sources where you can reach your realization other than through You?
• Is the lotus position any special advantage over sitting normally?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How does constant overthinking affect my spiritual energy?
• What are the dangers of psychic mediums and spirits?
• How to heal emotional trauma and subconscious blockages?

Have you ever felt exhausted from constantly planning the future? What changes when you finally let go and stay in the present moment?
